# company | Agentic Hub

> Expertise designed to scale your business through modern technology and operational silence.

## Core Capabilities
- **Technical Consultancy:** Strategic IT roadmaps, solution architecture and delivery across five practices.
- **Software Engineering:** Java / Jakarta EE, .NET & C#, Python & Django, PHP & Node.js, TypeScript / React / Angular, native & cross-platform mobile, Azure / AWS / Google Cloud.
- **Operational Silence:** Invisible, resilient, high-uptime systems; time & material staffing of senior engineers with no lock-in.
